statement.uz: Uch nomzodning ovozlari kiritiladi. Eng ko'p ovoz olgan g'olibni aniqlang.

title.uz: Kabisa yili

statement.uz: Yil kiritiladi. Yil 4 ga bo'linib 100 ga bo'linmasa yoki 400 ga bo'linsa — “Kabisa”, aks holda “Oddiy” deb chiqaring.
statement.en: A year is entered. If it is divisible by 4 but not by 100, or divisible by 400, print “Kabisa”, otherwise print “Oddiy”.

title.uz: Uchburchak yasash

statement.uz: Uchta tayoqcha uzunligi kiritiladi. Har qanday ikkitasining yig'indisi uchinchisidan katta bo'lsa “Ha”, aks holda “Yo'q” deb chiqaring.
statement.en: Three stick lengths are entered. If the sum of any two is greater than the third, print “Ha”, otherwise print “Yo'q”.

title.uz: Kino bileti

statement.uz: Kinoteatr narxni yoshga qarab belgilaydi: 6 yoshgacha — 0 (bepul), 6–17 yosh — 15000, 18–59 yosh — 30000, 60 va undan katta — 12000 so'm. Yosh kiritiladi, bilet narxini chiqaring.
statement.en: A cinema prices by age: under 6 — 0 (free), 6–17 — 15000, 18–59 — 30000, 60 and over — 12000. The age is entered; print the ticket price.

title.uz: Yetkazib berish narxi

statement.uz: Kuryer xizmati: 5 kg gacha (5 kg ham) yuk uchun 20000 so'm. Og'irroq bo'lsa, har bir ortiqcha kg uchun yana 4000 so'm qo'shiladi. Yuk og'irligi (butun kg) kiritiladi. Narxni chiqaring.
statement.en: A courier charges 20000 for parcels up to 5 kg (inclusive). For heavier ones, 4000 is added per extra kg. The weight (whole kg) is entered. Print the price.

title.uz: Baho harfi

statement.uz: Imtihon bali (0–100) kiritiladi. 90 va undan yuqori — A, 75–89 — B, 60–74 — C, 40–59 — D, 40 dan past — F. Harfni chiqaring.
statement.en: An exam score (0–100) is entered. 90 and above — A, 75–89 — B, 60–74 — C, 40–59 — D, below 40 — F. Print the letter.

title.uz: Chegirma pog'onalari

statement.uz: Xarid summasi 500000 va undan ko'p bo'lsa 15%, 200000 va undan ko'p bo'lsa 10% chegirma beriladi, aks holda chegirma yo'q. Summa kiritiladi, to'lanadigan pulni chiqaring.
statement.en: A purchase of 500000 or more gets 15% off, 200000 or more gets 10% off, otherwise no discount. The amount is entered; print the amount to pay.
